proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_feature_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage clause ('increases to 2d10') replaces the dice of a named sibling feature's extra-damage instance, not adds bonus damage on top. modify_damage_numeric is additive and general; it cannot express a targeted die-replacement upgrade to a specific named feature's existing damage atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The extra damage of your Brutal Strike increases to 2d10.

proposed_widenings.name: extend_feature_rider_count
proposed_widenings.justification: The 'two effects' clause increases the number of on-hit rider options the barbarian may select from the Brutal Strike feature in one use. No atom models a meta-count increase over the activation choices of a named sibling feature. This is not grant_extra_action (different economy), not scale_attack_count (no attack count), and not any passive grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can use two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use your Brutal Strike feature.

notes: Both parts of this feature are cross-feature upgrades that modify the mechanics of the sibling Brutal Strike (L9) unit rather than granting standalone mechanics. Part 1 requires replacing (not adding to) the extra-damage dice of a specific named feature. Part 2 requires increasing the count of selectable on-hit rider options for a specific named feature. Neither concept exists in the v4 effect-atom vocabulary or the current surface types. The passive family is syntactically available but no honest EffectAtom can carry either semantic. No dhall authored.
